title: Pepper and egg spaghetti
summary: Pepper and egg spaghetti is a italian dinner built around medium eggs and wholewheat spaghetti, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Start the sauce for Pepper and egg spaghetti: soften the onion, then add garlic and wholewheat spaghetti. Season medium eggs and have the pasta water on to boil.
steps.tip: Salt the pasta water. It is the only chance to season the noodles themselves.

steps.instruction: Cook medium eggs in the sauce while the pasta boils until tender with a bite. Save a cup of the cooking water before you drain.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, loosening it with a splash of pasta water so it clings to red peppers.
steps.tip: Taste Pepper and egg spaghetti before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Serve Pepper and egg spaghetti straight away in warm bowls.  Serve with the spaghetti, simmered in salted water until tender.
